authored_assumptions: Stylized 3D interpretation of the supplied Muse panda-and-dragon image, not reconstruction of unavailable geometry or fur.
Hidden back surfaces, full limb lengths, elbows, knees, topology, joint pivots and one-bone rigid skin weights are authored assumptions.
Anatomical left is world +X and anatomical right is world -X for the authored -Y-facing character; the shoulder dragon is on world -X/viewer-left.
right_shoulder is an unmapped helper attached to torso. dragon_root is its fixed descendant; raising the independently mapped upper_arm_right does not roll the dragon with that arm.
The golden sphere is a new fixed-shape action prop absent from the supplied reference; no material fabrication or physics is simulated.
Only the ten mapped body bones are keyed in these local clips. Head, hands, feet and dragon descendants keep their authored local rest pose; no finger/head/dragon actuation is inferred.
Weft uses its simulated body frames for appearance. Authored clips are retained as provenance and are not substituted for simulation actions or task rewards.
All colors are opaque diffuse factors with metallic=0 and roughness=1; the appearance is matte toy sculpture rather than recovered fur or scales.
Keyframe rotation/translation offsets use model rest axes, X right/Y rear/Z up; the builder converts through each bone rest basis.
rest_pose: Authored default bone transforms. Blender Z-up/-Y-front exported to glTF Y-up/+Z-front.
